# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes. Older versions are not patched; update to the
newest release from the [Releases page](https://github.com/PiratesIRC/Proofline/releases).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, not in a public issue:

1. Open the [Security tab](https://github.com/PiratesIRC/Proofline/security) of this repository.
2. Choose **Report a vulnerability** and fill in the form.

Include the Proofline version (Settings, About), your Windows version, what you did, what
happened and what you expected. Do not include your API keys, server passwords or text you
typed; describe them instead.

You should get a first reply within 7 days. If the report is confirmed, the fix ships in a new
release and the advisory is published after that release is out.

## Scope

In scope: the Proofline app, its installer and portable build, and the code in this repository.

Out of scope: LanguageTool itself and the AI providers Proofline can send text to. Report
problems in those to their own projects.
